texts.preamble: Rajesh Kumar Shivhare vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh Judgement ... on 27 January, 2014 W.P. No. 17405/2012 (R.K. Shivhare Vs. The State of Mp and another) 27.01.2014
texts.arguments: The learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the present petition has been filed as the Tribunal required to be constituted under the Food Safety and Standard Act 2006, has not been constituted as a result of which the appellate tribunal forum prescribed under section 70 of the Act is not available to the petitioner. The learned Government Advocate for the State submits that the Tribunal has been constituted by Gazette Notification dated 25th of October, 2013 and the District Judge has also been nominated for presiding over the same.
